title: Works pretty good but is quickly failing just months after getting it
text:
Works pretty good but is quickly failing just months after getting it. I got this about 6 months ago and already it won't take a full charge anymore. It DOES work and it worked great for a while but over 6 months it wore down and now after charging it, it's already down one bar. Not great quality.
Update: It killed over completely at the 10 month marker with occasional use. Worthless
